Blackrock Liquidity Funds T Fund Institutional Share Class | Cash Equivalents | index blank | spread dash | 3.68%

findings.detail: X05 treated two cash-equivalent fund yields as floating coupons even though the source shows no index and no spread.

rationale: The two flagged rows are explicitly classified in the filing as Cash Equivalents. Their Index cells are blank and their Spread cells are dashes; 3.69% and 3.68% appear in the Interest Rate column as money-market fund yields. A missing basis_spread is therefore source-correct, and X05 is out of scope for these rows.
